The entry, filed under identifier NCT01445171-results, states that the date recorded for this milestone is February 17, 2020. The study is listed with overall status COMPLETED, phase NA and an enrolment of 295 participants. The date field is flagged as "actual", which the record itself supplies.

The registered title is "Surgical Treatment of Aortic Stenosis With a Next Generation Surgical Aortic Valve".
